question: Non-Typical Candidate: Apple M2 Ultra / M3 Ultra Mac Studio. Up to 192GB Unified Memory, ~800 GB/s BW (M2 Ultra) or higher for M3. Price $4,000-$10,000+. Pros: Large capacity allows BF16/FP8 inference without extreme quantization. Cons: Lower bandwidth than top-tier datacenter GPUs, slower compute, limited ecosystem for high-performance local inference optimization (though MLX/Llama.cpp support exists).
